decision: Follow cited 2016 revision and FNA's infraspecific species concept: retain P. texensis with two varieties, var. texensis and var. ernestii; record ITIS's historical alternative P. ernestii species concept, not silently merge or rename without context

synonymy.var_texensis: Includes earlier Philadelphus texensis var. coryanus
synonymy.var_ernestii: Philadelphus ernestii S.Y.Hu treated as Philadelphus texensis var. ernestii (S.Y.Hu) Henrickson

source_reported_morphology.leaves: Opposite, lanceolate to lance-ovate, 1–3(–4.7) × 0.5–1(–2.3) cm, entire; petioles 2–7 mm
source_reported_morphology.buds: Exposed axillary buds rather than buds enclosed in petiole-base pouches
source_reported_morphology.flowers: Mostly solitary, terminal, 4-merous; white petals 8–14 mm; stamens 11–24
source_reported_morphology.fruit: Loculicidal capsule 3–6 mm in diameter with persistent sepals

diagnostic_character.var_texensis: Fine, tightly crinkled underlayer hairs typically present on lower leaf surface
diagnostic_character.var_ernestii: Usually lacks fine crinkled underlayer; longer appressed hairs present
diagnostic_character.limitation: Character variable, sometimes within the same plant; source reports magnification of 30–40× may be necessary when hairs sparse

name_conflict.itis: Older taxonomy lists P. texensis as synonym of P. ernestii
name_conflict.status: Documented authority/concept divergence, not unresolved absence of authoritative treatment

preservation: Additive research file only; no images or learner scoring changed
